sources.source_name: SIFMA 2026 Columbus Day fixed-income market closure recommendation
sources.purpose: Determine bond-market holiday and last-valid-session data freshness for daily Finance reports
sources.reliability_limits: SIFMA holiday closes are recommendations, not legally binding; actual member trading decisions and data availability may differ; 2026 event-specific release, check each year's official schedule.

learnings.title: Finance bond yield freshness must respect SIFMA market holidays
learnings.claim: SIFMA's 2026-09-29 official release recommends a full market close for U.S.-dollar-denominated fixed income in the U.S., U.K. and Japan on Monday 2026-10-12. This is a recommendation to members, not a legal market closure. A Monday 09:00 Europe/Istanbul Finance report must not present Friday's U.S. Treasury yield as a Monday live closing quote or infer zero yield change on a bond holiday.
learnings.decision: FINANCE_BOND_HOLIDAY_FRESHNESS_GATE: Check official SIFMA fixed-income holiday schedule and U.S. Treasury dated yield series before daily rate comparisons. Label last valid U.S. Treasury observation with exact date; mark same-day change N/A when no official observation. Equity and crypto calendars are independent.
learnings.next_measurement: In the next finance report verify last published Treasury business-day par yields and record source observation date; do not fill a holiday with Friday rates as new data.
fallback_history: If SIFMA current-year schedule cannot be fetched, consult the dated U.S. Treasury daily par yield table; mark current-day yield N/A until a dated official observation is available.
